posts.title: Set up proper battery care

slides.text:
Set up proper battery care
Cap charge at 80% if your vendor offers it
Cap charge at 80% if your vendor offers it
Avoid leaving it at 100% for weeks on end
Occasional deep discharge is fine, not daily

A battery at 80% capacity after 2 years is normal.
Save this — you'll need it next time.

posts.caption:
Set up proper battery care 💻

1. Cap charge at 80% if your vendor offers it
2. Avoid leaving it at 100% for weeks on end
3. Occasional deep discharge is fine, not daily
4. Keep firmware and battery drivers updated
5. A battery at 80% capacity after 2 years is normal.
